overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn appeared on the Medford Bytes podcast to discuss her bid for a third term, reflecting on city administration during and after COVID-19, municipal diversity, and upcoming commercial development.

items.title: Candidate Introduction and Favorite Local Restaurant
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn introduced herself and highlighted Fiore Italy as a favorite local dining spot.

items.title: Reflections on COVID-19 and City Administration
items.summary: Lungo-Koehn discussed managing Medford through the pandemic, stabilizing staff at City Hall, and addressing lingering impacts including school mental health needs.

items.title: City Hall Culture and Human Resources
items.summary: Lungo-Koehn described creating a dedicated human resources department and hiring a new director to increase accountability and improve municipal hiring standards.

items.title: Workforce Diversity and Community Representation
items.summary: Lungo-Koehn discussed efforts to diversify city staffing, fire exams, and police departments, noting increased female representation across municipal government.

items.title: Commercial Development and City Budget
items.summary: Lungo-Koehn outlined upcoming development projects to generate new tax revenue, including housing developments, life sciences, cannabis retail, and the Great American Beer Hall.

items.title: Constituent Communication and Campaign Priorities
items.summary: Lungo-Koehn shared her campaign priorities and detailed options for residents to connect with her, including local business office hours and direct email.

items.title: Women's World Cup Predictions and Closing
items.summary: Lungo-Koehn and the host briefly discussed predictions for the Women's World Cup before concluding the interview.
